title: 第996章 小师叔说得对第995章 长风去哪了
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
凌月也很快就一扫脸上的担忧，也很有信心的说道：“大师兄你说的对，长风师兄实力强大，他绝对不会有事的。”
秦怀安看到，虽然凌月嘴上这样说着，但眼神深处还是有一丝不易察觉的忧虑。
“对了，怀安，你说天宝圣地在紫荆山脉的驻地已经被你毁掉，能否细说一下。”道玄真人问道。
其他人也都竖起耳朵，这是他们现在最关心的问题。
这近百年来，天宝圣地占据了一部分的紫荆山脉，每天都会派人过来巡视紫荆圣地的护山大阵，而且好几次都尝试攻击这个护山大阵。
不过，这个护山大阵极为强大，远不是天宝圣地可以破解的。
甚至曾经有一次，天宝圣地组织数百名仙尊强者攻击阵法，依旧是无功而返。
不过，这也让他们见识到了天宝圣地的强大。
所以，在听说秦怀安独自一人毁灭天宝圣地的驻地之后，对于道玄真人他们的冲击极大。
秦怀安说道：“自从四十年前我返回紫荆大陆，就开始逐步的削弱天宝圣的实力......”
秦怀安把他从梧桐大陆返回紫荆大陆之后的事情，简要的述说了一遍。主要讲述了自己怎么对付天宝圣地。
当然，具体的战斗细节，秦怀安并未详细讲述。
“这次，我阵法修为有所突破，这才依靠阵法，攻破了天宝圣地的护山大阵。”
“不过，虽然毁掉了天宝圣地，在紫荆山脉的驻地，但还是让将近两百名仙尊修士逃脱了。”
秦怀安听到秦怀安以一己之力，经过数十年的谋划，竟然把如此庞大的宗门分部，打的弃阵而逃，都是震惊不已。
“秦师弟，你晋级大罗金仙了吗？”等秦怀安讲完，凌月突然问道。
其他人也都面色异样的看着秦怀安。不仅仅是凌月，其他人也都感觉，这可不是仙尊可以做到的事。
那不是几人、几十人，那是数百名的仙尊强者。如果不是大罗金仙，又有哪个仙尊境界的修士，可以同时对付如此众多的同阶修士？
秦怀安苦笑摇头：“怎么可能，我才修炼多少年，距离大罗金仙还有很长的距离要走。不过我阵法已经突破到了六阶仙阵师的水平，能击败天宝圣地，完全是因为阵法的原因。”
秦怀安并未隐瞒他的阵法水平，现在恐怕整个紫荆大世界都已经知道他是一名六阶仙阵师了。

“怀安你竟然已经晋级六阶仙阵师，那也相当于半个大罗金仙了。如果排布得当，甚至普通大罗金仙都要吃亏。”道玄真人不由的感叹道。
他的师尊苍瀚真人，当初就是紫荆大陆最出色的阵法师。但受限于当初紫荆大陆的限制，不仅修为无法突破到金仙往上，甚至阵法也只能达到四阶仙阵的极限。
否则，道玄真人相信，当初的苍瀚真人，绝对可以晋级五阶仙阵师。
秦怀安晋级六阶仙阵师对于道玄真人的震撼，甚至比他晋级大罗金仙还要大。
要知道，那个仙阵师不是耗费大量的时间钻研阵道，甚至为了钻研阵道，很多人都耽误了自身的修炼。
而秦怀安呢，不仅修炼速度远超常人，甚至阵法水平也在短短数百年，就达到了六阶仙阵师的水平。
这是让道玄真人更加无法理解的。可能，只能用天赋异禀来解释了。
“小师叔，那我们是不是可以离开护山大阵了？”穆紫琳恭敬的抱拳行礼道。
秦怀安每次看到穆紫琳那一板一眼的样子，就有一种反差感。十几岁少女的面容，却犹如老学究般严肃认真的表情，产生了强烈的反差。
秦怀安摇摇头说道：“护山大阵短时间内，恐怕还是不能开启。根据我得到的消息，天宝圣地的圣主段临川，正在前往紫荆大陆的路上，最多一个月时间就会抵达。段临川已经渡过大罗金仙雷劫，是一名大罗金仙，实力极其强大。”
“如果段临川来到紫荆大陆，那些从紫荆山脉逃走的天宝圣地弟子，必然会再度聚集。他们很有可能会再次对我们紫荆圣地不利。”
“大罗金仙？！”无尘惊叫一声。
其他人脸上也露出一丝惊惧之色，他们也知道大罗金仙的恐怖。
大罗金仙不仅仅已经跳出天地灾刧，可真正永恒于天地间。实力修为更是远超太乙金仙，可以说是一个质变。
他们一直在这个护山大阵之中，并不知道外界的情况。现在听说天宝圣地的圣主，竟然已经晋级大罗金仙，而且还很快就要到了，这让他们怎能不惊惧。
秦怀安说道：“各位不用担心，我看我们紫荆圣地这个护山大阵极为强大，应该是最顶级的六阶仙阵。段临川也只是初入大罗金仙，想要破开此阵法，基本不可能。”
“而且，段临川的主要目标也不是紫荆圣地，而是我秦怀安。如果我不在紫荆圣地，我相信，段临川也不敢轻易就对我们的护山大阵发起攻击。”
“经此一役，段临川恐怕也不敢轻易激怒于我。”
“怀安，你还要离开？这个护山大阵如此强大，你只要在这里面安心修炼一段时间，凭借你的资质，说不定用不了多久，你也可以晋级大罗金仙。到时候，就算段临川恐怕也奈何不得你了。”
“没有护山大阵的保护，那段临川可能就会专门开始针对你。”

“对，秦师弟，你就在这护山大阵中好好修炼！”凌月也附和道。
“呵呵，道玄师兄你们放心，就算是段临川，想要杀我也不是那么容易的。”秦怀安淡淡笑道。
“只要我在外面，对于天宝圣地就是一个威胁，他们就不敢下死手对付紫荆圣地。而且，一直在护山大阵中修炼，对于我的提升也是一个限制，只有在外面闯荡，才能更快的提升修为。”
“小师叔说得对，师尊，等小师叔离开的时候，我也想外出历练一番。”穆紫琳说道。
content_en:
Ling Yue quickly wiped away the worry on her face and said confidently: "Senior Brother, you are right. Senior Brother Changfeng is very powerful, and he will definitely be fine."
Qin Huaian saw that although Ling Yue said this, there was still a trace of unnoticeable worry deep in his eyes.
"By the way, Huai'an, you said that Tianbao Holy Land's station in the Bauhinia Mountains has been destroyed by you. Can you elaborate on it?" Master Daoxuan asked.
Everyone else also pricked up their ears, this was their biggest concern right now.
In the past hundred years, Tianbao Holy Land has occupied part of the Bauhinia Mountains. Every day, people are sent to inspect the mountain-protecting formation of Bauhinia Holy Land, and they have tried to attack the mountain-protecting formation several times.
However, this mountain-protecting formation is extremely powerful and cannot be broken by Tianbao Holy Land.
Even once, Tianbao Holy Land organized hundreds of powerful immortals to attack the formation, but they still failed.
However, this also allowed them to see the power of Tianbao Holy Land.
Therefore, after hearing that Qin Huaian single-handedly destroyed the Tianbao Holy Land, they were greatly shocked by Master Daoxuan and others.
Qin Huaian said: "Since I returned to Bauhinia Continent forty years ago, I have gradually weakened Tianbaosheng's strength..."
Qin Huaian briefly recounted what happened after he returned to Bauhinia Continent from Wutong Continent. It mainly talks about how to deal with Tianbao Holy Land.
Of course, Qin Huaian did not describe the specific details of the battle in detail.
"This time, I made a breakthrough in my formation cultivation, and then relied on the formation to break through the mountain-protecting formation of Tianbao Holy Land."
"However, although Tianbao Holy Land and the station in the Bauhinia Mountains were destroyed, nearly two hundred Immortal Lord monks were able to escape."
Qin Huaian was shocked when he heard that Qin Huaian single-handedly, after decades of planning, had managed to make such a huge sect branch abandon its formation and flee.
"Junior brother Qin, have you advanced to Daluo Jinxian?" Ling Yue suddenly asked after Qin Huaian finished speaking.
The others also looked at Qin Huaian with strange expressions. Not only Ling Yue, but everyone else also felt that this was not something that the Immortal Lord could do.
Those were not just a few people, but dozens of people, they were hundreds of powerful immortals. If it is not Daluo Jinxian, which monk in the Immortal Realm can deal with so many monks of the same level at the same time?
Qin Huaian smiled bitterly and shook his head: "How is it possible? I have only been practicing for a few years, and I still have a long way to go before becoming a Daluo Golden Immortal. However, my formation has already broken through to the level of a sixth-level immortal formation master. I can defeat Tianbao Holy Land entirely because of the formation."
Qin Huaian did not hide his formation level. Now I am afraid that the entire Bauhinia world knows that he is a sixth-level immortal formation master.
"Huai'an, you have actually advanced to the sixth level of Immortal Formation Master, which is equivalent to half a Daluo Jinxian. If arranged properly, even ordinary Daluo Jinxian will suffer." Master Daoxuan couldn't help but sigh.
His master, Master Cang Han, was the most outstanding formation master in the Bauhinia Continent. However, due to the original restrictions of the Bauhinia Continent, not only the cultivation level could not break through to the Golden Immortal level, but even the formations could only reach the limit of the fourth-order Immortal Formation.
Otherwise, Master Daoxuan believed that the original Master Canghan could definitely advance to the fifth level of Immortal Formation Master.
Qin Huaian's promotion to the sixth level Immortal Formation Master shocked Dao Xuan even more than his promotion to Daluo Jinxian.
You must know that the immortal formation master did not spend a lot of time studying the formation, and even in order to study the formation, many people delayed their own cultivation.
As for Qin Huaian, not only did his cultivation speed far exceed that of ordinary people, but his formation level also reached the level of a sixth-level immortal formation master in just a few hundred years.
This makes Daoxuan even more incomprehensible. Perhaps, it can only be explained by his extraordinary talent.
"Uncle Junior, can we leave the mountain-protecting formation?" Mu Zilin said respectfully, cupping her fists and saluting.
Qin Huaian looks at it every timeThere was a sense of contrast in Mu Zilin's serious look. There was a strong contrast between the face of a teenage girl and the serious expression of an old scholar.
Qin Huaian shook his head and said: "I am afraid that the mountain protection formation will not be activated in a short period of time. According to the information I received, Duan Linchuan, the Holy Lord of Tianbao Holy Land, is on his way to Bauhinia Continent and will arrive in a month at most. Duan Linchuan has survived the Thunder Tribulation of the Great Luo Golden Immortal. He is a Great Luo Golden Immortal and is extremely powerful."
"If Duan Linchuan comes to the Bauhinia Continent, those Tianbao Holy Land disciples who escaped from the Bauhinia Mountains will definitely gather again. It is very likely that they will be detrimental to our Bauhinia Holy Land again."
"Daluo Jinxian?!" Wuchen screamed.
There was also a look of fear on the faces of the others, and they also knew the terror of Daluo Jinxian.
Daluo Jinxian has not only escaped from the disasters of heaven and earth, but can truly remain in heaven and earth forever. The strength and cultivation level far exceed that of Taiyi Golden Immortal, which can be said to be a qualitative change.
They have been in this mountain-protecting formation and don't know the situation outside. Now that they heard that the Holy Master of Tianbao Holy Land had been promoted to Da Luo Jinxian, and was about to arrive soon, how could they not be frightened.
Qin Huaian said: "Don't worry, everyone. I think our mountain-protecting formation in the Bauhinia Holy Land is extremely powerful. It should be the top-level sixth-level immortal formation. Duan Linchuan is just a newcomer to the Great Luo Golden Immortal. It is basically impossible to break through this formation."
"Moreover, Duan Linchuan's main target is not the Bauhinia Holy Land, but me, Qin Huaian. If I were not in the Bauhinia Holy Land, I believe that Duan Linchuan would not dare to attack our mountain protection formation easily."
"After this battle, Duan Linchuan probably won't dare to anger me easily."
"Huai'an, you want to leave? This mountain-protecting formation is so powerful. As long as you practice peacefully here for a period of time, with your qualifications, you may be able to advance to Da Luo Jinxian in a short time. By then, even Duan Linchuan may not be able to help you."
"Without the protection of the mountain guard formation, that section of Linchuan might start targeting you specifically."
"Yes, Junior Brother Qin, you should practice well in this mountain-protecting formation!" Ling Yue also agreed.
"Haha, don't worry, Brother Daoxuan, even Duan Linchuan will not be so easy to kill me." Qin Huaian smiled lightly.
"As long as I am outside, I will be a threat to the Tianbao Holy Land, and they will not dare to deal with the Bauhinia Holy Land. Moreover, practicing in the mountain-protecting formation is also a restriction on my improvement. Only by wandering outside can I improve my cultivation level faster."
"My junior uncle is right, Master. When my junior uncle leaves, I also want to go out and have some experience." Mu Zilin said.
